messages.text: Hello, this is Test Contact from the catering order on Thursday.
Hello, thanks for the message. How can I help?
The final invoice is ready. You can settle the balance of 1,850 here: https://pay.example.com/inv/CT-7731 - payments go to Harbourview Test Catering.
Our menu for next month is on https://menu.example.org/winter if you want to have a look :)
